{{Quote|When are you and your troops leaving?''"<br />"''Oh, maybe in a few weeks, maybe never. Maybe a ''permanent'' presence here is what you people really need&hellip; some good, healthy ''discipline''.|[[Rallo]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Turrant]]|<ref name="Lucky" />}}
'''Gus Talon''' was one of the three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Conference on Gus Talon|conference]] was held on the contested [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to discuss how the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] should respond to the recent increase in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity in the region.<ref name="Power Down" />

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Gus Talon was occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] while a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell operated in a [[Gus Talon settlement|settlement]] of the moon. At the same time, a young [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] worked on Gus Talon as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. There, he fell in love with [[Mala Tinero]], who was killed by the Empire during a retaliatory [[Bombing of Gus Talon|bombardment]] of the moon. Her [[Death/Legends|death]] gave Antilles a deep hatred of the Empire and caused him to join the fledgling Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Lucky" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gus Talon made its first appearance in the comic story "[[Lucky (comic story)|Lucky]]." It was described in the comic as a "Corellian moon", which contradicted the sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which claimed that Corellia had no moons. This inconsistency was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] in [[2008]] by ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which described Gus Talon as a "moon of Corellia".

In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', three moons could be viewed from the surface of Corellia, as well as from space. One of these moons must have been Gus Talon.
